environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 native function on AWS Lambda. API Gateway REST API (v1) with a usage plan attached to the stage. The usage plan enforces per-client throttle of 2 requests/second with burst of 3. Additionally, an AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the API Gateway stage containing a single custom rate-based rule (not a managed rule group) with a threshold of 100 requests per 5-minute window per source IP, action BLOCK. The rate-based rule uses the forwarded IP from X-Forwarded-For with fallback to source IP. Note: the WAF rule is rate-based only — it does NOT inspect request bodies or payloads. The usage plan's throttle settings are the primary control. Lambda reserved concurrency set to 1 to serialize execution.
